# amiRobotAI
> AI Robotics & Process Automation Companion — dual-engine verified

## What is amiRobotAI?
amiRobotAI is a dual-engine AI companion for robotics, RPA, and industrial automation. Two AI models (Grok + DeepSeek) cross-verify every response — automation advice you can trust.

## Features
- RPA design (UiPath, Power Automate, n8n, bot architecture, process mining)
- Industrial robotics (SCARA, 6-axis, cobots, safety standards, PLC integration)
- Process optimization (bottleneck analysis, ROI, KPIs, change management)
- IoT & edge computing (MQTT, OPC-UA, predictive maintenance, data pipelines)
- AI in automation (computer vision QC, NLP, anomaly detection, digital twins)
- Integration (ERP/MES, API design, middleware, legacy bridging)

## Architecture
- Dual-engine: Grok 4.5 (xAI) + DeepSeek
- Anti-confabulation: trigram-cosine concordance >= 0.45 required
- Stateless: queries processed in real-time, never stored

## Compliance
- EU AI Act (Reg. 2024/1689) Art. 50 — limited-risk, full transparency
- GDPR (Reg. 2016/679) — minimal data, no query storage
